summary: Completed pixel-perfect migration of the TalkMe React + TypeScript application to native Android Jetpack Compose in /app. Built a unified design system, reusable Compose design components, reactive state architecture mirroring AppContext, all 14 screens and lesson views (including Lesson 1 Hello A0, 10-Stage Grammar Framework, and Course Levels 3D nature map with padlock), and connected native TextToSpeech synthesis. Both compile_applet and lint_applet pass with zero errors.
